name: Fujii Ren
source:
A lone wolf lacking in sociality. He may appear rather mature for his age, but is fast to lose his cool when complimented over his effeminate features - a trait that became somewhat of a complex for him. While normally agreeable with others, he draws a clear line between himself and the rest of his schoolmates, with the exception of a few close friends.

Unfortunately, about two months prior, a brutal fight inexplicably broke out between him and [url=https://vndb.org/c29002]Shirou Yusa[/url] - his best friend - that left both of them hospitalized, placing Ren's already fickle reputation at school in complete jeopardy.

"If you could just get back whatever you've lost right away, wouldn't that make it worthless to begin with?"

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1986219362/dies-irae-english-localization-project-commences/description]Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page[/url]]
translation:
一个缺乏社交能力的独行侠。他看起来比实际年龄成熟，但别人夸奖他偏女性化的外貌时就会立刻失去冷静——这已经成了他的心结。平时他与人相处融洽，却会和其他同学划清界限，只有少数亲近的朋友例外。

不幸的是，大约两个月前，他与最好的朋友[url=https://vndb.org/c29002]游佐四郎[/url]莫名爆发了一场激烈冲突，两人都因此住院，让他本就摇摆不定的校内名声陷入危机。

“如果你能立刻找回失去的东西，那它从一开始不就毫无价值了吗？”
